proofUses.reason: Critical torus upper scale from lattice tails and finite-vertex counting.
The proof explores the quotient cluster by lifting each queried edge to a fresh edge of G and uses deferred decisions under adaptive exploration (GSLG) to identify the product law on H.
The proof uses Markov's inequality on the count of vertices in large components and a layer-cake integral; it invokes no other wiki assertion.
